---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for adudu
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Is your request related to a problem?
A clear description of the pain point. Ex. "I can't easily import notes from …"

## Describe the solution you'd like
What you'd like adudu to do, and how it should behave.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
Any workarounds or other tools you tried.

## Additional context
Screenshots, mockups, examples, or links that help explain the idea.

## Scope hint
Tell us if you think this fits the **free** core (offline knowledge base, lookup, launcher) or might belong in a future **Pro** tier (e.g. advanced sync/backups, extra formats). This is a suggestion only — nothing is gated or paid in the beta.
